title: The Letter Shift Matrix
description: 🧩 Locked Filing Cabinet slip with alternating +1 / -1 letter shifts applied to the original word.
question: Decrypt 'T D D Q F S' where odd letters were shifted +1 and even letters were shifted -1:
hints: Reverse it: subtract 1 from T -> S; add 1 to D -> E; subtract 1 from D -> C; add 1 to Q -> R; subtract 1 from F -> E; add 1 to S -> T.
solution: Reversing the alternating shift on 'T D D Q F S' yields 'SECRET'.
